title: Ruppelt's study of sightings near nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Well, yeah, it would be Edward J. Pelt's original study where he came in that was done from 1947 1952 and then he wrote a book about it in 1956.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to an early study of UFO sightings by a man named Edward J. Ruppelt, carried out between 1947 and 1952. Ruppelt then wrote a book about it in 1956. Michels brings it up as early evidence of sightings clustering near nuclear sites, which would suggest the objects took a special interest in nuclear weapons.
